title: Stripe paid $7B for the meter
angle: The margin is moving to the billing layer, not the model layer.

frames.text: Stripe just paid $7B for a company that doesn't build models.
For OpenRouter, the gateway that routes requests between AI models.
Its valuation in May. Stripe paid more than 5x that.
Moves your request to the cheapest model that can handle it.
Not the model. The meter. Someone has to count tokens and bill for them.
Turns out the plumbing might be the moat after all.
